data.name: ZeroMission AB
data.description: ZeroMission AB is a Stockholm-based climate strategy consultancy and carbon credit reseller founded in 2006. The company helps businesses measure, reduce, and offset emissions, selling credits from nature-based projects (Plan Vivo afforestation, biochar) and offering climate accounting and advisory services. It is a broker/consultant within the carbon credit ecosystem rather than a CDR supplier.
